service_description: Wiring, outlet and switch repair, circuit breaker upgrades, ceiling fan and light fixture installation, and EV charger setup.
Leak and pipe repair, drain unclogging, faucet replacement, water heater installation, and sewer line maintenance.
Air conditioning and furnace installation, repair, and servicing. Duct cleaning, thermostat setup, and heat pump installation.
Interior and exterior house painting, cabinet refinishing, drywall patching, wallpaper installation, and popcorn ceiling removal.
Trim and molding, door and window installation, custom shelving, staircase repair, and general wood repairs.
Hardwood, laminate, vinyl, tile, and carpet installation. Floor sanding, refinishing, and grout repair.
Roof leak repair, shingle replacement, gutter cleaning and guard installation, skylight repair, and roof inspections.
Standard and deep cleaning for homes, move-in/move-out cleaning, and recurring housekeeping services.
Carpet and upholstery cleaning, window washing, pressure washing, pool maintenance, and chimney sweeping.
Lawn mowing, edging, sod installation, garden bed design, mulching, and sprinkler system installation.
Tree trimming and removal, hedge and shrub shaping, and stump grinding.
Patio and walkway paving, retaining wall construction, deck building, and fence installation.
Treatment for ants, roaches, spiders, termites, bed bugs, rodents, mosquitoes, and wildlife removal.
Full and partial kitchen and bathroom renovation including cabinetry, countertops, tile, fixtures, and plumbing.
Basement finishing, garage conversion, room additions, and general structural remodeling.
Installing and repairing dishwashers, refrigerators, washers, dryers, ovens, and garbage disposals.
Lock and deadbolt installation, security camera and alarm system setup, smart doorbells, and motion sensor lighting.
TV mounting, home theater setup, Wi-Fi and mesh network configuration, and smart home device installation.
Garage door and opener repair, driveway sealing and crack repair, and concrete leveling.
Minor home repairs, furniture assembly, picture hanging, caulking, weatherstripping, and odd jobs.
